criteria.text: The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of any type of solid tumor malignancy or lymphoma.

source.text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of any type of solid tumor malignancy or lymphoma:

criteria.text: In the Phase 1 Dose Escalation portion, the participant has any advanced solid tumor of Head and Neck Cancers (of any types), Esophageal cancer, Lung cancers (of any types), Mesothelioma, or Pancreatic cancers.

source.text:
Phase 1 Dose Escalation only: Subjects with

(A) any advanced solid tumors of

1. Head and Neck Cancers ("HNC") (of any types),
2. Esophageal cancer,
3. Lung cancers (of any types),
4. Mesothelioma,
5. Pancreatic cancers,

criteria.text: In the Phase 1 Dose Escalation portion, the participant has any NTRK1 gene fusion positive ("NTRK1+") solid tumors or lymphomas, that is relapsed, refractory or intolerant (R/R/I) to standard of care (SOC) and for which there is no approved or curative therapy. Additionally, patients must not be candidates for or have exhausted regimens known to provide clinical benefit, including hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in lymphoma patients if they are deemed transplant eligible.

source.text:
Or,

(B) any NTRK1 gene fusion positive ("NTRK1+") solid tumors or lymphomas, that is relapsed, refractory or intolerant (R/R/I) to standard of care (SOC) and for which there is no approved or curative therapy. Additionally, patients must not be candidates for or have exhausted regimens known to provide clinical benefit, including hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in lymphoma patients if they are deemed transplant eligible.

criteria.text: In the Phase 2 Monotherapy and Combination with Pembrolizumab portion, the participant must have TrkA-driven HNC, Esophageal, Lung, Mesothelioma, Pancreatic cancers; or, any NTRK1+ solid tumors or lymphoma*, that is R/R/I to SOC.

source.text:
Phase 2 Monotherapy and Combination with Pembrolizumab only:

Subjects must have

1. TrkA-driven HNC, Esophageal, Lung, Mesothelioma, Pancreatic cancers; or,
2. any NTRK1+ solid tumors or lymphoma\*, that is R/R/I to SOC.

criteria.appliesTo: Phase 2 Monotherapy and Combination with Pembrolizumab

criteria.text: The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1.

source.text: * Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status: 0 or 1.

criteria.text: The participant is able to swallow and retain oral medication.

source.text: * Able to swallow and retain oral medication.

criteria.text: The participant either has available archival tumor tissue samples, or consents to tumor tissue sampling prior to the first dose.

source.text: * Subjects must either have available archival tumor tissue samples, or consent to tumor tissue sampling prior to the first dose.

criteria.text: The participant has adequate organ system function as defined as follows: Absolute neutrophil count ≥1.5x10^9/L, Hemoglobin ≥9g/dL, Platelets ≥100x10^9/L, PT/INR, PTT ≤1.5xULN, Total bilirubin ≤1.5x ULN, AST, ALT ≤2.5xULN, Creatinine ≤1.2xULN for age, weight, Calculated creatinine clearance or 24h urine creatinine clearance ≥60mL/min.

source.text:
* Adequate organ system function as defined as follows:

  1. Absolute neutrophil count ≥1.5x10\^9/L
  2. Hemoglobin ≥9g/dL
  3. Platelets ≥100x10\^9/L
  4. PT/INR, PTT ≤1.5xULN
  5. Total bilirubin ≤1.5x ULN
  6. AST, ALT ≤2.5xULN
  7. Creatinine ≤1.2xULN for age, weight
  8. Calculated creatinine clearance or 24h urine creatinine clearance ≥60mL/min

criteria.text: The participant received chemotherapy having delayed toxicity within the last 14 days (six weeks for prior nitrosourea or mitomycin C).

source.text: * Received chemotherapy having delayed toxicity within the last 14 days (six weeks for prior nitrosourea or mitomycin C).
